name: underline-link
title: Underline Link
description: A text link whose underline draws itself in when the reader points at it or tabs to it, from the start of the line to the end, and wraps across lines with the text. For links in running text, navigation and footers where a hard underline on every link…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/underline-link

Installed to `components/ui/effects/underline-link.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/underline-link';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/underline-link

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
